title: Person holds authenticated identity
relationship_invariant: A person is not equal to an account; binding is explicit and governed.
optionality: An account must bind to exactly one person.

title: Person holds organization membership
relationship_invariant: Membership does not confer representative authority.

title: Representative authority scopes a person to an organization
relationship_invariant: Authority is explicit and scoped, never implied by membership or role.

title: Organization holds affiliation case
cardinality: One organization to many cases across seasons.
relationship_invariant: A case belongs to exactly one organization.

title: Affiliation case belongs to season
relationship_invariant: One case per organization per season.

title: Requirement version applies under policy version
cardinality: Many requirement versions to one policy version.
relationship_invariant: A requirement applies only under its effective policy version.

title: Response satisfies requirement version
cardinality: One response per requirement version per case.
relationship_invariant: Completeness is derived from responses to the applicable requirement set.

title: Evidence metadata supports response
cardinality: Many evidence items to one response.
relationship_invariant: Evidence binary content remains external; only metadata is governed here.

title: Submission snapshot captures case state
relationship_invariant: A snapshot is immutable; resubmission creates a new snapshot.

title: Decision record resolves affiliation case
cardinality: One active decision per case review outcome.
relationship_invariant: A decision is distinct from the activation it may authorize.

title: Reviewer assignment binds reviewer to case
relationship_invariant: An assignment is not a reviewer role.

title: Fee obligation scoped to affiliation case
cardinality: One or more obligations per case.
relationship_invariant: Financial status is scoped to explicit finance authority.

title: Reconciliation binds obligation, acknowledgement, and confirmation
relationship_invariant: Reconciliation requires both acknowledgement and accounting confirmation.

title: Activation follows decision and reconciliation
relationship_invariant: Approval is not activation; activation is a distinct governed fact.

title: Correction record supersedes prior fact
cardinality: Many corrections to one corrected entity.
relationship_invariant: Corrections preserve prior history via supersession.

title: Audit event records governed transition
cardinality: Many audit events to one case.
relationship_invariant: Audit events are append-only and never mutated.
